answer: Bind each agent identity to a bonded deposit that is locked for many epochs and forfeited if the peer jury slashes it. A sybil swarm then needs one full bond per puppet, so the attacker's cost grows linearly with the number of fake identities while a single honest agent pays once. Withdrawals must pass a cooldown, and any reputation gain has to be echoed by independent attested peers before it counts, so a fresh ember of trust cannot be manufactured on a private mesa of self-graded accounts. Cheap disposable identities stop paying off.
